text.p: Tropical Storm Fern is currently east of the Northern Marianas and is moving tracking east. Top winds have diminished to 50 mph and are expected to continue as it tracks to the east and dissipates by 24-36 hours. The threat to shipping will diminish as the storm dissipates.

Tropical cyclone Fergus, with winds of 75 mph, is accelerating to the south at 30 mph. Fergus should be near the north island of New Zealand by 12 hours as it continues to transition into an extratropical weather system. Heavy rains and gusty winds are possible on the north island at that time. Fergus will fully transition into an extratropical system by 24 hours.

Tropical cyclone Phil continues to track slowly off the northwest Australian coast. Top winds are near 85 mph and will likely strengthen to near 120 mph by 48 hours at which time Phil will be a significant threat to shipping in waters northwest of Australia.
